Hello everyone. Today I'm going to show you an example of how to run a sequential agent with ADK. Let me briefly cover what a sequential agent is: it's an agent that runs specialized sub-agents in a sequence. This is very useful for use cases where we know the pattern of execution — for example, we read a PDF file, we extract the information, we store it in BigQuery. It will always be the same. So this is a straightforward implementation, especially for when we need to debug these agents easily.
